blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints.
We present WorldCrafter , a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose.
The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator’s limited token budget.
Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences.
By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt.
Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.
blocks.zh:
视频世界模型能够对动态环境进行互动探索,但努力在长期和跨观点中尊重先前的观察。
我们介绍WorldCrafter, 一个视频世界模型,
关键的观点是让所请求的观点决定多视图证据如何压缩到视频生成器有限的象征性预算之中。
与视频生成器,内存编码器和装设条件的读出模块联合训练,在解密前将历史观测数据整合到一组固定的目标视域特定符号中,没有明确的深度对应.
通过将这个内存与最近的时间上下文和几步蒸馏相结合,WorldCrafter使流传的场景探索能够从单一的输入图像或文本的提示中进行.
跨越静态和动态场景的实验显示,在长视距一致性和照相机控制准确性方面有很大提高,同时在分钟的探索中保持视觉质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments by generating new observations as users move the camera [ 50 , 65 , 19 , 15 , 51 , 36 , 73 , 47 , 104 ] .
Maintaining a coherent world requires memory beyond the recent context so that previously observed content remains consistent when revisited, even from a different viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
视频世界模型在用户移动相机时生成新的观测结果,从而可以对动态环境进行互动探索[50、65、19、15、51、36、73、47、104]。
维持一个连贯的世界需要超越最近背景的记忆,以便以前观察到的内容在重新审视时保持一致性,即使从不同的观点来看也是如此。

blocks.en:
A straightforward way to provide memory for video world models is to include previously generated frames in attention.
Full-history attention incurs substantial computation costs [ 23 , 9 , 84 ] , while selective history retrieval trades view coverage for efficiency [ 79 , 89 , 84 , 9 , 12 , 38 , 60 , 75 , 73 , 62 ] .
Explicit spatial memories provide a shared 3D reference but depend on accurate geometry and struggle with dynamic scenes [ 76 , 101 , 88 , 94 ] . Implicit memories compress history into learned representations [ 59 , 95 ] , with recent methods incorporating geometry features for 3D awareness [ 68 , 74 , 26 ] . However, these geometry-oriented representations prioritize geometric prediction over the appearance fidelity needed to reproduce previously observed scenes [ 63 ] .
blocks.zh:
为视频世界模型提供内存的一个直截了当的方法是将先前生成的帧纳入关注范围.
全面历史关注需要大量的计算成本[23,9,84],而选择性历史检索行业则要查看效率的覆盖范围[79,89,84,9,12,38,60,75,73,62].
清晰的空间记忆提供了共享的3D参考,但依赖于精确的几何和与动态场景的奋斗[76,101,88,94]. 隐性记忆将历史压缩成学到的表达[59,95],近代方法包含几何特征用于3D认知[68,74,26]. 然而,这些面向几何的表示法将几何预测置于重现先前观察到的场景所需的外观忠诚度之上[63].

blocks.en: Recent advances in 3D representation learning [ 63 , 31 , 33 , 32 ] have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in learning compact scene representations, making them a natural foundation for the memory space of video world models. Motivated by this, we present WorldCrafter , a video world model with implicit 3D-aware memory for consistent interactive generation. At its core, a memory encoder initialized from pretrained 3D representation encoders maps historical latent frames into a compact memory space, inheriting their learned 3D inductive bias. We further optimize this memory space by jointly training the memory encoder, video diffusion transformer (DiT), and a memory readout module, enabling the memory to co-adapt with the DiT token space.
blocks.zh: 立体化表现学习的最新进展[63,31,33,32]在学习紧凑场景表现方面表现出了卓越的能力,使其成为视频世界模型记忆空间的自然基础. 基于这个动机,我们呈现了WorldCrafter,一个带有隐含的3D-意识记忆的视频世界模型,用于一致的互动生成. 在其核心上,一个内存编码器从预先训练的3D表达编码器初始化,将历史潜伏的帧映射到紧凑的内存空间中,继承了他们学到的3D诱导偏差. 我们通过联合训练内存编码器,视频传播变压器(DiT),和一个内存读出模块,使内存能够与DiT符号空间共同适应,进一步优化了这个内存空间.

blocks.en:
To extract generation-relevant information from this memory, we compare pose-free and pose-guided readout under a fixed token budget.
Pose-guided readout focuses on information relevant to the requested viewpoints and yields better revisit consistency and camera control in our experiments.
The resulting tokens condition the DiT directly through self-attention, without reconstructing target-view images.
During interaction, we select complementary historical views according to their joint camera coverage and combine the queried memory with recent temporal context.
The memory supplies historical scene information, while recent context supports the continuation of visible motion.
Generated chunks are added to the history archive, while the encoder input size and DiT memory-token budget remain fixed.
Together with camera-conditioned autoregressive generation and few-step distillation, our model achieves real-time streaming inference while preserving precise camera control and minute-scale consistency under complex user-specified camera trajectories.
blocks.zh:
为了从这个内存中提取出与生成相关的信息,我们在固定的代号预算下比较了无假名和有假名指导的读出.
Pose-guided readout侧重于与所要求的观点有关的信息,并使我们在实验中更好地重新审视一致性和相机控制。
由此产生的符文直接通过自觉来对DiT进行条件化,而不重建目标视图图像.
在互动过程中,我们根据其联合摄像头覆盖情况选择补充性的历史观点,并将被询问的记忆与最近的时间背景结合起来。
内存提供历史场景信息,而最近的上下文则支持可见运动的继续.
生成的块被添加到历史档案中,而编码器输入大小和DiT内存-token预算仍然固定.
我们的模型与相机条件的自动递归生成和几步蒸馏法一起,在复杂的用户指定相机轨迹下,实现了实时流线推论,同时保持了精确的相机控制和分级一致性.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce an implicit 3D-aware memory mechanism for video world models. It learns to encode history latent frames into a compact memory representation that preserves spatial-temporal context, enabling efficient memory writing and readout within a fixed token budget. • We integrate this memory mechanism into camera-controllable autoregressive video generation, achieving leading revisit consistency (47.6% improvement relative to the strongest baseline) and camera-control accuracy, with controlled ablations supporting our design. • We build a real-time interactive system through few-step
distillation, achieving streaming inference while maintaining visual quality
throughout minute-scale exploration.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive Video World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 互动视频世界模式

blocks.en: Video world models generate future observations in response to user actions, turning video generation into interactive simulation [ 27 , 8 , 2 , 67 ] . Recent methods increasingly combine streaming generation with camera control to support real-time interaction and long-horizon exploration [ 50 , 19 , 18 , 104 , 73 , 55 , 16 , 30 , 62 , 60 , 88 , 1 , 47 , 48 , 14 , 100 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型生成未来针对用户动作的观测结果,将视频生成转化为交互式模拟[27,8,2,67]. 近代方法日益结合流体生成与相机控制,支持实时交互和长视距探索[50,19,18,104,73,55,16,30,62,60,88,1,47,48,14,100,25].

blocks.en: Streaming generation extends video diffusion through rolling denoising or temporally varying noise levels [ 34 , 10 , 57 , 58 , 11 ] , while autoregressive distillation and rollout-aware training improve sampling efficiency and mitigate error accumulation [ 87 , 28 , 45 , 105 , 103 ] . Flexible history conditioning supports longer rollouts [ 61 , 22 ] , complemented by efficient streaming designs and parallel implementations [ 82 , 13 , 102 ] . However, extending temporal rollouts alone does not ensure faithful recall of previously observed scenes.
blocks.zh: 流化生成通过滚动减音或时空变化的噪声水平[34,10,57,58,11]扩展视频传播,而自旋蒸馏和推展意识培训则提高采样效率并减缓误差积累[87,28,45,105,103]. 弹性历史调节支持更长时间的推出[61,22],辅之以高效的流线设计和平行实施[82,13,102]. 然而,仅仅延长时间范围并不能确保忠实地回顾以前观察到的场景。

blocks.en: Camera control is commonly implemented through discrete action inputs [ 15 , 90 , 36 , 73 , 46 , 30 ] , continuous camera parameters [ 71 , 20 , 6 , 39 , 97 , 4 , 80 , 5 , 21 ] , or point-cloud renders along the target trajectory [ 93 , 56 , 92 ] . Although these signals specify viewpoint changes, they do not provide a persistent state that preserves scene content beyond the context window. Thus, combining streaming generation with camera control alone remains insufficient for consistent long-horizon exploration.
blocks.zh: 相机控制通常通过离散的动作输入[15,90,36,73,46,30],连续相机参数[71,20,6,39,97,4,80,5,21],或点云沿目标轨迹制成[93,56,92]. 尽管这些信号指定了视角变化,但它们并没有提供持续状态,保存上下文窗口以外的场景内容. 因此,光是将流体发电和相机控制结合起来,仍不足以进行持续的长期勘探。

blocks.en: 2.2 Memory Mechanisms in Video World Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频世界模式中的记忆机制

blocks.en: Persistent video world models require memory beyond the recent video context. We categorize existing approaches according to their stored representations: context memory, spatial memory, and implicit memory.
blocks.zh: 持续的视频世界模型需要超越最近视频背景的记忆. 我们根据所储存的表达方式对现有的方法进行分类:上下文内存,空间内存,以及隐含的内存.

blocks.en:
Context memory retains historical frames, latent tokens, or cached attention features for attention-based reuse [ 79 , 89 , 73 , 62 , 98 , 49 , 23 , 9 , 78 , 14 ] .
Frame-retrieval methods select a small subset using camera overlap or reconstructed surfaces [ 89 , 38 , 24 , 17 ] , while learned querying can aggregate information across the available history.
MemLearner [ 91 ] uses query tokens that attend to both historical context and noisy predictions in shallow DiT layers; deeper layers consume the queries without the original context tokens.
CaR [ 53 ] compresses historical latents and retrieves them through relative-camera attention inside the denoising network.
These methods learn to access historical context within the generator. WorldCrafter instead aggregates history into a 3D-aware memory representation using a pretrained multi-view encoder, then reads out fixed-size memory tokens before denoising.
blocks.zh:
上下文内存保留了历史框架、潜在标志或缓存的注意力特性,用于基于注意力的再利用[79、89、73、62、98、49、23、9、78、14]。
帧检索方法使用相机重叠或重建的表面选择一个小子集[89,38,24,17],而学习的查询则可以汇总整个可用历史的信息.
MemLearner [91] 使用既关注历史背景又关注浅层DiT层中噪音预测的查询符;更深层在没有原始上下文符的情况下消耗查询符.
CAR[53]压缩历史潜伏物,通过去诺网络内部的相对摄像头关注来回收.
这些方法学习在生成器内获取历史背景. WorldCrafter将历史综合到使用预先训练的多视图编码器的3D-意识内存代表,然后在解密前读出固定大小的内存符号.

blocks.en: Spatial memory instead transforms history frames into views specified by target camera poses [ 93 , 56 , 76 , 101 , 88 , 72 , 37 , 94 , 81 ] . Representative methods perform this transformation via novel view synthesis, encode the synthesized target-view frames into the VAE latent space, and concatenate the resulting latents channel-wise with the input noise to condition video diffusion models [ 93 , 56 , 72 , 37 , 76 ] . The resulting spatial correspondence across viewpoints facilitates revisiting previously observed regions. However, strong alignment to the target view can overconstrain scene dynamics, limiting their ability to model dynamic objects and environments.
blocks.zh: 空间内存转而将历史帧转化为目标相机所指定的视图[93、56、76、101、88、72、37、94、81]。 具有代表性的方法通过新颖的视图合成来进行这种转变,将合成的目标-视图框架编码为VAE潜在空间,并将由此产生的潜在通道与输入噪声结合,以条件视频传播模型[93、56、72、37、76]。 由此产生的各种观点的空间对应关系有助于重新审视以前观察到的区域。 然而,与目标视图的强烈配合可能会过度限制场景动态,限制了他们模拟动态物体和环境的能力.

blocks.en:
Implicit memory encodes history into learned representations [ 59 , 95 , 75 , 12 , 40 ] .
Existing methods update memory recurrently alongside local context [ 59 , 95 , 54 , 77 ] or compress observations using learned encoders [ 75 , 12 ] .
Geometry-aware approaches draw on pretrained geometry estimators such as VGGT [ 68 ] : CineScene [ 26 ] uses their features as generation conditions, while GIM-World [ 74 ] distills them into memory through geometric supervision.
However, geometry-estimation pretraining prioritizes geometric prediction over the appearance fidelity needed for consistent visual recall [ 63 ] .
WorldCrafter instead adapts multi-view scene representations learned through novel-view reconstruction, which requires preserving both geometry and appearance.
Initialized from LagerNVS [ 63 ] , our memory encoder and readout inherit a learned 3D inductive bias and are jointly optimized with the video generator.
blocks.zh:
隐性记忆将历史编码为学到的表达[59,95,75,12,40].
现有方法与本地上下文一起反复更新内存[59,95,54,77]或使用已学习的编码器压缩观察 [75,12].
几何感知方法借鉴了VGGT[68]等预先训练的几何感知模型: CineScene[26] 使用它们的特征作为生成条件,而GIM-World[74]通过几何监督将其蒸馏成内存.
然而,几何-估计预训将几何预测置于连续视觉记忆所需的外观忠诚度之上[63].
而WorldCrafter则适应了通过小说-观点重建学到的多景场景表现,这需要同时保留几何和外观.
从LagerNVS [63] 初始化,我们的内存编码器和读取器继承了学习到的3D诱导偏差,并与视频生成器共同优化.

blocks.en: The overview of our pipeline is shown in Figure 2 . The video DiT generates the first chunk conditioned on camera poses alone, as no history is yet available. As history accumulates, we learn a memory encoder to map history latent frames into a compact 3D-aware representation, which is read out as a fixed-size memory 𝐌 \mathbf{M} to condition subsequent generation.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道概况见图2。 视频 DiT 生成第一个以相机形式为条件的块, 因为还没有历史 。 随着历史的积累,我们学习了一个内存编码器,将历史潜伏框架映射成一个紧凑的3D-意识代表,它被读出为固定大小的内存M\mathbf{M}以条件后代.

blocks.en:
Memory conditioning. At each denoising step, the DiT processes [ 𝐌 ; 𝐳 r ; 𝐳 t ] [\mathbf{M};\mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{r}};\mathbf{z}_{t}] as a single latent sequence.
This adds a dedicated memory stream to the recent history while preserving chunk-level causality.
Unlike prior context-based memory methods [ 79 , 89 , 62 , 73 ] that instantiate 𝐌 \mathbf{M} as a fixed-length context retrieved from the accumulated history 𝐳 h \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}} , we model 𝐌 \mathbf{M} by mapping 𝐳 h \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}} into a compact 3D-aware implicit memory representation.

这在保留块级因果关系的同时,为最近的历史增加了一个专门的内存流.
与之前的基于上下文的内存方法[79,89,62,73]将 M\ mathbf{M}作为从累积历史中检索的固定长上下文 z h\ mathbf{z\ mathhrm{h}不同,我们通过将 M\ mathbf{M} 映射 z h\ mathb{z\ mathhrm{h} 变成一个紧凑的 3D - 意识隐含内存代表.

blocks.en:
Camera conditioning. The target trajectory 𝐂 \mathbf{C} specifies a camera-to-world pose and camera intrinsics for each frame.
Following PRoPE [ 39 ] , we encode relative camera geometry as a positional transformation within self-attention.
We implement this conditioning using the parallel camera-attention branch of UCPE [ 97 ] , which adopts independent query, key, and value projections and adds its output to the original self-attention through a zero-initialized projection.
The camera branch is applied only to the noisy part 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} of the concatenated sequence; the memory 𝐌 \mathbf{M} and recent context 𝐳 r \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{r}} are processed without camera injection.

PROPE [39] 之后,我们编码相对相机几何,作为自觉内的位置转换.
我们利用UCPE[97]的平行相机注意分支执行这个条件,该分支采用独立的查询,密钥,和值预测,并通过零初始化的投影将其输出加入原始的自注意.

blocks.en:
Memory writing. As shown in Figure 2 , after generating the first chunk, the memory encoder Φ \Phi writes the accumulated history latents 𝐳 h \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}} and their corresponding camera parameters 𝐂 h \mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{h}} into an implicit 3D-aware representation 𝐑 \mathbf{R} : 𝐑 = Φ ⁡ ( 𝐳 h , 𝐂 h ) ∈ ℝ | 𝐳 h | ​ L × d , \mathbf{R}=\Phi(\mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}},\mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{h}})\in\mathbb{R}^{|\mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}}|L\times d}, (5) where | 𝐳 h | |\mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}}| denotes the number of history latent frames.
The encoder produces L L tokens of dimension d d per history latent frame.

We initialize the encoder architecture and weights from the LagerNVS encoder [ 63 ] , discarding its shallow image-processing layers and adding a new patch embedding layer to map each latent frame directly into its representation space.
The history camera poses are expressed relative to the latest latent frame in 𝐳 h \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}} and injected as camera tokens during encoding.
The resulting representation tokens 𝐑 \mathbf{R} aggregate geometry and appearance information across the input history without materializing an explicit 3D reconstruction.

我们从LagerNVS编码器中初始化编码器架构和权重[63],丢弃其浅薄的图像处理层,并添加一个新的补丁嵌入层,将每个潜在框架直接映射到其代表空间.
历史相机姿势在z h\ mathbf{z}^{\ mathrm{h}}}中相对于最新的潜伏框架表示,并在编码时作为相机符号注入.
由此产生的表示符 R\ mathbf{R} 整个输入历史中的总几何和外观信息, 但没有实现明确的 3D 重建 。

blocks.en:
Since the length of 𝐑 \mathbf{R} grows linearly with the number of input history frames | 𝐳 h | |\mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}}| , to bound the cost of the encoder, we restrict its input to k k history latent frames.
At inference, we retain the latest latent frame in 𝐳 h \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{h}} and greedily select k − 1 k-1 complementary frames whose joint field of view (FoV) maximizes coverage of the target region along the upcoming camera trajectory.
We denote the selected history latents and their camera parameters by 𝐳 s \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{s}} and 𝐂 s \mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{s}} , respectively.
Prior context-based memory methods [ 79 , 89 , 73 , 62 ] retrieve only a few history frames by ranking their pairwise FoV similarity to target poses [ 89 , 73 ] , resulting in limited coverage and sensitivity to individual selections.
In contrast, our memory encoder accommodates more history frames under a comparable budget, while max-coverage history retrieval yields broader coverage and greater robustness.

blocks.en: 3.4 Base Model Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 基地模式培训

blocks.en: Dataset curation. Our training data combine the Open-Sora-Plan (OSP) dataset [ 41 ] , DL3DV [ 43 ] , and synthetic videos from MIND [ 83 ] , covering diverse indoor and outdoor scenes and object motions. We use Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] to obtain metric-scale camera pose annotations across all data sources and Qwen2.5-VL [ 7 ] to generate video captions. Using these captions and the estimated camera trajectories, we further curate a subset of the OSP dataset in which the camera follows moving subjects, helping the model learn coordinated camera and subject motion.
blocks.zh: 数据集目录. 我们的训练数据结合了Open-Sora-Plan(OSP)数据集[41],DL3DV[43],以及来自MIND[83]的合成视频,涵盖了各种室内外场景和物体运动. 我们使用深度 Anything 3 [42] 来获取所有数据源的公制尺度相机显示注释,以及 Quen2.5-VL [7] 生成视频字幕. 利用这些字幕和相机估计轨迹,我们进一步整理了OSP数据集的一个子集,其中相机跟踪移动主题,帮助模型学习协调相机和主题运动.

blocks.en: Training details. We initialize the video DiT from Helios-base [ 96 ] and train our base model in 4 stages. The original Helios-base inference window contains a 9-frame noise chunk and a FramePack-style clean history [ 98 ] comprising a compressed 16-frame segment, a 2-frame segment, the latest latent frame, and an attention-sink frame. We remove its compressed 16-frame segment and prepend memory tokens equivalent in number to the tokens of 4 uncompressed history frames.
blocks.zh: 培训详情。 我们从Helios基地初始化视频DiT [96] 分四个阶段训练我们的基地模型. 最初的Helios基推论窗口包含一个9帧噪声块和一个FramePack风格的清洁历史[98],包括一个压缩的16帧片段,一个2帧片段,最新的潜伏片段,以及一个注意力沉淀片段. 我们移除其压缩的16帧部分,并预置相当于4个未压缩历史帧的符号的内存符.

blocks.en: In the first stage, we fine-tune Helios-base to adapt to our modified inference window. For each sampled video chunk, we randomly select 4 history frames from the preceding 4 chunks to populate the memory slots. We train on 760,000 videos from the OSP dataset for 5,000 iterations using 32 GPUs with a global batch size of 32.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段,我们微调Helios基座,以适应我们修改后的推论窗口. 对于每个样本的视频块,我们随机从之前的4块中选择4个历史帧来充充充内存插槽. 我们使用32个GPU对来自OSP数据集的760,000个视频进行培训,用于5 000个迭代,全球批量规模为32个。

blocks.en: In the second stage, we introduce camera control by training the UCPE-based camera conditioning branch while keeping the video DiT backbone frozen. We use 40,000 videos from the filtered OSP subset and 6,000 videos from DL3DV, training on 32 GPUs with a global batch size of 128.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们通过培训基于UCPE的相机调节分支,同时保持视频DiT主干线的冻结,引入了相机控制. 我们使用过滤过的OSP子集的40,000个视频和DL3DV的6,000个视频,对32个GPU进行培训,全球批量尺寸为128个.

blocks.en: In the third stage, we adapt our memory encoder to process VAE latents. We initialize it from the LagerNVS encoder and replace its shallow DINO layers with a latent patch embedding layer, as described in Sec. 3.3 . The encoder takes a fixed number of 9 latent frames as input. We warm up the memory encoder on DL3DV and the filtered OSP subset for 5,000 iterations using 16 GPUs with a global batch size of 16.
blocks.zh: 在第三阶段,我们调整我们的记忆编码器 处理VAE潜伏。 我们从LagerNVS编码器中初始化,并用潜在的补丁嵌入层取代其浅的DINO层,如Sec所述. 3.3 (英语). 编码器采用固定数字9个潜伏框架作为输入. 我们在DL3DV上的内存编码器和过滤过的OSP子集上热身,使用16个GPU,全球批量大小为16个.

blocks.en: In the final stage, we introduce a memory readout module that outputs a fixed number of memory tokens matching the token count of 4 full frames. We jointly train this module with the memory encoder, video DiT, and camera conditioning branch to co-adapt the learned memory representation and the DiT token space. We first train on DL3DV and the filtered OSP subset for 8,000 iterations using 32 GPUs with a global batch size of 32, then incorporate synthetic videos from MIND for 1,000 additional iterations to improve dynamic subject modeling.
blocks.zh: 在最后阶段,我们引入一个内存读出模块,输出一个固定数量的内存符,与4个全帧的符号计数匹配. 我们与内存编码器,视频DiT和相机调节分支共同训练这个模块,以共同适应所学到的内存表现和DiT标志空间. 我们首先在DL3DV和过滤过的OSP子集上进行训练,用于8000个迭代,使用32个GPU,全球批量大小为32个,然后将来自MIND的合成视频装入1000个额外的迭代,以改善动态主题模型化.

blocks.en: 3.5 Distillation for Real-time Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.5 实时相互作用的蒸馏

blocks.en: Pyramid distillation. Following Helios [ 96 ] , we adopt a coarse-to-fine pyramid denoising scheme and apply distribution matching distillation [ 86 , 85 ] to reduce the number of sampling steps. We use 3 spatial resolutions with 2 denoising steps per resolution. To support camera conditioning across the pyramid, we rescale the spatial coordinates while keeping the camera poses and field of view unchanged across pyramid levels during UCPE camera embedding.
blocks.zh: 金刚杵蒸. 继Helios [96] 之后,我们采用了粗细的金字塔解码方案,并应用分布匹配蒸馏[86,85]以减少采样步骤的数量. 我们使用3个空间分辨率,每个分辨率有两个去名步骤。 为了支持跨金字塔的相机调制,我们在UCPE相机嵌入期间对空间坐标进行调整,同时保持相机的姿势和视场在金字塔层之间保持不变.

blocks.en:
Hybrid distilled model. We observe a trade-off between visual fidelity and subject-following ability when distilling with synthetic data. Incorporating synthetic data [ 83 ] improves the model’s subject-following ability, but can also introduce smeared textures. To preserve both subject-following ability and natural visual details, we distill a low-noise model and a high-noise model with different training data compositions. The low-noise model is distilled from the base model before synthetic data adaptation, using the filtered OSP subset and DL3DV dataset to preserve natural appearance. The high-noise model is distilled from the base model after synthetic data adaptation, using a mixture of OSP, DL3DV, and MIND to retain subject-following ability. During inference, the low-noise model performs the last denoising step, while the high-noise model performs all the preceding steps.
After distillation, WorldCrafter-fast can achieve a generation speed of 16 fps on a 4-GPU machine.
blocks.zh:
混合蒸馏模型. 我们观测到,在用合成数据蒸馏时,视觉忠贞度和跟随对象的能力之间是一种权衡。 纳入合成数据[83]提高了模型的标本跟踪能力,但也能够引入涂抹纹理. 为了保留主题跟随能力和自然视觉细节,我们提炼出一个低噪声模型和一个具有不同训练数据构成的高噪声模型. 低噪音模型在合成数据适应前从基模型中蒸馏出来,使用过滤过的OSP子集和DL3DV数据集来保存自然外观. 高噪音模型在合成数据适应后从基模型中蒸馏出来,使用OSP,DL3DV和MIND的混合物来保留主体跟随能力. 在推论期间,低噪模型执行最后的除噪步骤,而高噪模型则执行前述所有步骤.
蒸馏后,WorldCrafter-fast可以在4-GPU机上实现16英尺的一代速度.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmark. We curate a benchmark to evaluate memory ability, camera-control accuracy, and visual quality in long-horizon video world models. The benchmark contains 145 images from HappyOyster [ 19 ] , Project Genie [ 50 ] , web sources, and images generated by GPT-Image2, covering 83 dynamic object-centric scenes and 62 static scenes. Each image and its text description are paired with 5 metric camera trajectories, yielding 725 videos per method. The trajectories span 528–1,648 frames and include closed-loop revisits to assess whether previously observed content is preserved over long horizons.
blocks.zh: 基准。 在长视视频世界模型中,我们管理一个评估内存能力,相机控制精度,视觉质量的基准. 该基准包含来自HappyOyster [19],Project Genie [50]的145幅图像,网络来源,以及GPT-Image2生成的图像,涵盖83个动态的以物体为中心的场景和62个静态场景. 每个图像及其文字描述都配有5个公制相机轨迹,每个方法产生725个视频. 轨距跨度为528-1,648帧,包括闭路重访,以评估以前观测到的内容是否在长视野内保存。

blocks.en: Comparison methods. We evaluate two variants of our method: WorldCrafter and its distilled counterpart, WorldCrafter-fast. We compare our models with 8 recent camera-controllable video world models: DreamX-World [ 16 ] , Alaya-EVOKE [ 88 ] , HY-WorldPlay [ 62 ] , Lyra 2.0 [ 60 ] , Echo-WM [ 100 ] , LingBot-World 2 [ 18 ] , Matrix-Game 3.5 [ 55 ] , and SANA-WM [ 104 ] .
blocks.zh: 比较方法. 我们评估了我们方法的两个变体:WorldCrafter及其蒸馏的对应物WorldCrafter-fast. 我们的模型和8个最近的相机控制视频世界模型比较: DreamX-World [16],阿拉亚-EVOKE [88],HY-WorldPlay [62],Lyra 2.0 [60],Echo-WM [100],LingBot-World 2 [18],Matrix-Game 3.5 [55],以及SANA-WM [104].

blocks.en: These baselines span different memory representations and camera-conditioning mechanisms. HY-WorldPlay and DreamX-World retrieve history context based on camera similarity and use PRoPE [ 39 ] for camera control. SANA-WM combines Gated DeltaNet memory with UCPE [ 97 ] and Plücker-ray conditioning, whereas Echo-WM employs a UCPE-based camera branch and sliding-window memory. Alaya-EVOKE and Lyra 2.0 construct spatial memory using depth estimated by Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] and condition generation through geometric warping. Matrix-Game 3.5 combines geometric patch memory with Warped PRoPE, using VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 69 ] and Depth Anything 3 for metric-scale geometry annotation.
blocks.zh: 这些基线跨越不同的内存表示和相机调节机制. HY-WorldPlay和DreamX-World基于相机相似性检索历史背景,并使用PRoPE [39]用于相机控制. SANA-WM 组合 三角洲 Echo-WM则使用基于UCPE的相机分支和滑窗内存. Alaya-EVOKE和Lyra 2.0利用深度Anything 3[42]估计的深度和通过几何warping生成条件来构建空间内存. 矩阵-Game 3.5将几何补丁内存与Warded PRoPE结合,使用VGGT-配位\Omega [69] 和深度任意3进行公尺几何注释.

blocks.en: We evaluate the full-step base model with a refiner for SANA-WM, the full-step base models for Lyra 2.0 and HY-WorldPlay, and the distilled models for the remaining baselines. All methods receive identical initial images, text descriptions, and target trajectories. Before evaluation, we resize the generated videos to 640 × 384 640\times 384 to ensure a common evaluation resolution.
blocks.zh: 我们用SANA-WM的精炼器来评价全步基模型,Lyra 2.0和HY-WorldPlay的全步基模型,以及剩余基线的蒸馏模型. 所有方法都接收相同的初始图像,文本描述,以及目标轨迹. 在评价前,我们将生成的视频大小调整为640×384 640\times 384,以确保共同的评价分辨率.

blocks.en: 4.2 Memory Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 内存评价

blocks.en: Following the protocol in [ 65 ] , we evaluate memory ability by comparing frames generated upon revisiting a location with the corresponding frames from the initial visit. We report MEt3R [ 3 ] , LPIPS [ 99 ] , PSNR, and SSIM [ 70 ] to assess consistency between the paired observations.
blocks.zh: 根据[65]中的协议,我们评价内存能力,办法是将重访地点时生成的帧与初始访问时的相应帧进行比较。 我们报告Met3R[3],LPIPS[99],PSNR,和SSIM[70],以评估对联观测结果的一致性.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 5 , our models achieve the top two results on all 4 metrics, with WorldCrafter-fast performing best. Compared with Lyra 2.0, WorldCrafter reduces LPIPS from 0.487 to 0.255 and increases PSNR from 14.050 to 18.016 dB. The agreement across these metrics indicates that revisited views more faithfully recover the appearance and structure of earlier observations, supporting the effectiveness of the learned memory representation in long-horizon closed-loop exploration.
Figures 5 and 7 compare first-visit and revisit frames on static and dynamic scenes, together with point clouds reconstructed from the generated videos using VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 69 ] . WorldCrafter’s revisit frames closely match the corresponding first-visit observations, while its generated videos yield coherent point clouds with well-aligned camera poses. These qualitative results further indicate that WorldCrafter preserves scene structure and appearance during long-horizon video generation while maintaining visual quality.
blocks.zh:
如表5所示,我们的模型在所有4个度量标准上都取得了两个最高的成绩,其中WorldCrafter-fast成绩最好。 与Lyra 2.0相比,WorldCrafter将LPIPS从0.487减少到0.255,并将PSNR从14.050增加到18.016 dB. 横跨这些衡量标准的协议表明,重新审视的观点更忠实地恢复了早期观测的外观和结构,支持了在长视闭路探索中学习到的内存表现的有效性.
图5和图7对静态和动态场景的首访进行对比并重温帧,同时使用 VGGT - 组合\Omega [69] 从生成的视频中叠加的点云。 WorldCrafter的重新审视框架与相应的第一访问观察密切匹配, 这些定性结果进一步表明,WorldCrafter在长视视频生成过程中保留了场景结构和外观,同时保持视觉质量.

blocks.en: 4.3 Camera Control Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 相机控制评价

blocks.en:
We sample the generated videos at a stride of 4 frames and recover camera trajectories using VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 69 ] . Following SANA-WM [ 104 ] , each trajectory is normalized relative to its first pose and aligned using Umeyama Sim(3) alignment [ 66 ] . Evaluation metrics include rotation error (RotErr), camera-center translation error (TransErr), and pose-matrix discrepancy (CamMC), with lower values indicating more accurate camera control.
As shown in Table 5 , WorldCrafter achieves the lowest error on all 3 metrics, while WorldCrafter-fast ranks third on each metric.
blocks.zh:
我们用4帧的脚步对生成的视频进行取样,并使用VGGT-ship========================================================== 在SANA-WM [104] 之后,每个轨迹相对于其第一个姿势实现正常化,并使用Umeyama Sim(3)对齐 [66]. 评价的度量包括旋转错误(RotErr),相机-中心翻译错误(TransErr),以及姿势-矩阵差异(CamMC),较低的值表示更准确的相机控制.
如表5所示,WorldCrafter在所有3公尺上实现了最小的误差,而WorldCrafter-fast则在每个公尺上排名第三.

blocks.en: 4.4 Visual Quality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.4 视觉质量 评价

blocks.en:
Following SANA-WM [ 104 ] , we evaluate video generation quality using VBench [ 29 ] in custom-input mode. We report Subject Consistency (SC), Background Consistency (BC), Temporal Flickering (TF), Motion Smoothness (MS), Aesthetic Quality (AQ), Imaging Quality (IQ), Dynamic Degree (DD), and Overall Consistency (OC).
As shown in Table 7 , our models achieve the best results in 5 of the 8 dimensions. WorldCrafter obtains the highest overall score of 81.910, while WorldCrafter-fast achieves the best Temporal Flickering score. These gains primarily reflect stronger scene consistency and temporal coherence across the generated videos, complementing the results of the memory evaluation.
blocks.zh:
根据SANA-WM [104],我们用自定义输入模式的V Bench [29] 来评价视频生成质量. 我们报告主题一致性(SC)、背景一致性(BC)、瞬间闪烁(TF)、运动平滑(MS)、审美质量(AQ)、成像质量(IQ)、动态度(DD)和总体一致性(OC)。
如表7所示,我们的模型在8个层面中的5个层面取得了最佳成果。 WorldCrafter获得81.910的总得分最高,而WorldCrafter-fast则获得最佳Temperal Flickering得分. 这些成果主要反映了场景更加一致和所制作的视频的时间更加一致,是对内存评价结果的补充。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: All ablations are conducted on WorldCrafter before distillation, following the memory and camera-control evaluation protocols in Secs. 4.2 and 4.3 . Table 9 compares the full model with 4 variants under the same training and inference settings.
blocks.zh: 在蒸馏前,按照第4.2和第4.3节的内存和相机控制评价协议,在WorldCrafter进行所有喷雾。 表9将完整的模型与相同培训和推论环境下的4个变体进行比较。

blocks.en:
Implicit 3D-aware memory versus context memory. The context memory variant replaces the memory tokens produced by the memory encoder and memory readout module with 4 retrieved history latent frames. It is initialized from the second-stage model in Sec. 3.4 and further trained for the same number of iterations as the full model.
Table 9 shows that this replacement degrades both revisit consistency and camera control.
To examine how memory retention varies over time, Figure 9 (a) plots mean revisit LPIPS against the frame interval between the initial observation and its revisit.
WorldCrafter exhibits a slower increase in revisit error, with a widening advantage over context memory at longer intervals.
blocks.zh:
隐含的3D-意识记忆相对于上下文记忆. 上下文内存变体将内存编码器和内存读出模块产生的内存符号替换为4个检索历史潜伏框架. 它从第3.4 Sec.的第二阶段模型中初始化,并接受了与完整模型相同数量的迭代的进一步训练.
表9显示,这种替换既会降低一致性,也会降低摄像机控制。
为了审查内存的保存方式如何随时间而变化,图9(a)图表示重新审视LPIPS与初始观测与其重新审视之间的框架间隔。
WorldCrafter显示重访错误增加速度较慢,相对于上下文存储器的优势越来越大,间隔时间更长.

blocks.en: Joint optimization of the memory encoder and video generator. The frozen memory encoder variant fixes the encoder during the final training stage, while keeping the memory readout module, video DiT, and camera conditioning branch trainable. This variant yields weaker memory and camera-control performance in Table 9 . Figure 9 (b) tracks validation performance at matched training iterations: joint optimization reaches lower revisit error earlier and maintains this advantage. This supports co-adapting the memory representation with the video generator instead of learning to consume a fixed representation space.
blocks.zh: 联合优化内存编码器和视频生成器. 被冻结的内存编码器变体在最后的训练阶段固定编码器,同时保留内存读出模块,视频DiT,以及相机调制分支可列车. 该变体在表9中产生较弱的内存和相机控制性能. 图9 (b) 在匹配的培训迭代中跟踪验证性能:联合优化更早地达到更低的重访错误并保持这一优势. 这支持与视频生成器共同适应内存表示,而不是学习消耗固定的表示空间.

blocks.en: Memory readout. The pose-free memory readout variant maps the encoded representation to memory tokens without target-pose queries, retaining the same history inputs and output token budget. Table 9 shows that pose-guided readout improves both memory and camera control ability.
blocks.zh: 记忆读取. 无假名内存读出变体将编码的表示图映射到内存符号上,没有目标拥有查询,保留了相同的历史输入和输出符号预算. 表9显示,姿势制导读取既能提高内存又能提高相机控制能力.

blocks.en: History retrieval. To isolate the effect of history retrieval, the similarity-based history retrieval variant replaces max-coverage retrieval with pairwise FoV similarity ranking. Both variants retain the latest latent frame and select 8 additional history frames as the memory encoder input, with the same DiT memory-token budget. Table 9 shows improved revisit consistency and camera control with max-coverage retrieval. This comparison favors selecting complementary views that jointly cover the target region over independently ranking views by similarity, without increasing the number of history inputs.
blocks.zh: 历史检索. 为了隔离历史检索的效果,基于相似性的历史检索变体用双向FOV相似性排名取代最大覆盖检索. 两个变体都保留了最新的潜伏框架,并选择另外8个历史框架作为内存编码器输入,其DiT内存-token预算相同. 表9显示重新审视的一致性和相机控制与最大覆盖检索的改进情况。 这种比较有利于选择可共同覆盖目标区域的补充观点,而不是按相似程度独立排列观点,而不会增加历史投入的数量。

blocks.en: Memory efficiency. Depth-based spatial memory methods, including Lyra 2.0 [ 60 ] , Matrix-Game 3.5 [ 55 ] , and Alaya-EVOKE [ 88 ] , rely on estimated geometry to reuse history observations. We compare the additional cost of depth estimation and warping with that of WorldCrafter’s memory encoder and readout. Figure 9 (c) reports component latencies at 640 × 384 640\times 384 resolution, with a generation chunk of 9 latent frames and 4 history frames for spatial warping. Shared VAE decoding for RGB output and video denoising are excluded. For spatial memory, the depth estimation and alignment process takes 0.409 s using Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] , while the batched warping takes 0.937 s, totaling 1.346 s per chunk. By operating directly on history latents, WorldCrafter requires 0.049 s for memory encoding and 0.013 s for readout, totaling 0.062 s. This reduces the summed memory-processing cost by a factor of 21.7 × 21.7\times , without requiring explicit depth estimation or warping.
blocks.zh: 内存效率. 基于深度的空间内存方法,包括Lyra 2.0 [60],Matrix-Game 3.5 [55],以及Alaya-EVOKE [88],依靠估计几何来重用历史观测. 我们把深度估计和扭曲的额外费用与WorldCrafter的记忆编码和读取费用进行比较。 图9 (c) 报告640×384 640\时分辨率的延迟部分,代号为9潜在帧和4个历史帧,用于空间拼接。 不包括用于RGB输出和视频解码的共享VAE解码. 对于空间内存,深度估计和对齐过程需要使用深度Anything 3 [42] 的0.409 s,而批量waring则需要0.937 s,总计每块1.346 s. 通过直接在历史潜伏上操作,WorldCrafter需要0.049 s进行内存编码,0.013 s进行读取,总计0.062 s. 这使得总和的内存处理成本减少了21.7×21.7\时间,而不需要明确的深度估计或扭曲。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We present WorldCrafter, a camera-controllable autoregressive video world model with implicit 3D-aware memory. A learned memory encoder aggregates history latent frames into a compact representation, which is read out as tokens compatible with the video DiT. Experiments demonstrate improved revisit consistency and camera-control accuracy over the evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍WorldCrafter,一个相机可控自动递归的视频世界模型,带有隐含的3D-意识记忆. 已学习的内存编码器将历史潜在框架汇总成一个紧凑的表示式,被读出作为与视频DiT兼容的标志。 实验显示,在评估的基线上,重新审视的一致性和相机控制精度有所提高。

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Consistency can still break down along particularly complex or extended trajectories. In addition, re-encoding history at every chunk incurs extra latency. A promising direction is an autoregressive streaming memory encoder that incrementally incorporates each newly generated chunk into the memory state, reducing repeated computation over history.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 一致性仍然可以沿着特别复杂或扩展的轨道分解. 此外,每块重新编码历史都会产生额外延迟。 一个有希望的方向是自动回流的内存编码器,该编码器将每个新生成的块逐渐并入内存状态,减少历史的重复计算.
